title: llm-serving
description: One Karpenter GPU pool serving one vLLM model: optional KV tiering, AI gateway routing, KEDA autoscaling and Prometheus recording rules.

name.description: The one value holding the model name; the Deployment, ServiceAccount, route match, ScaledObject target and every selector derive from it.

s3Uri.description: S3 prefix of the checkpoint; the trailing slash is required (the prefix must hold config.json, tokenizer files and *.safetensors).

awsRegion.description: Region of the models bucket; rendered as the pod's AWS_REGION.

karpenter.title: Karpenter GPU pool
karpenter.description: NodePool + EC2NodeClass and the AWS-side inputs from `terraform output chart_values_yaml`.

poolName.description: NodePool/EC2NodeClass name; also the value of the karpenter.sh/nodepool node label the Deployment selects with.

nodeRole.description: IAM role Karpenter uses to launch nodes.

discoveryTag.description: Value of the karpenter.sh/discovery tag on the subnets, security groups and nodes.

amiAlias.description: Pinned Bottlerocket AMI alias; 'latest' would drift every node on a new AMI publish.

instanceStorePolicy.description: How the local NVMe is formatted; the Karpenter v1.15.1 CRD accepts only RAID0.

vllm.title: vLLM serve image and flags
vllm.description: Structured values rendered into the container args (vLLM v0.32.0).

image.description: vLLM image; ENTRYPOINT is ["vllm","serve"], so the args start with the model URL.

kvCacheDtype.description: --kv-cache-dtype; one of the vLLM CacheDType literals (auto, fp8, fp8_e4m3, fp8_e5m2, ...).

gpuMemoryUtilization.description: --gpu-memory-utilization. A string on purpose: the arg needs the literal 0.90 and an unquoted float would render as 0.9.

tiering.title: KV tiering
tiering.description: Adds the kv-transfer-config arg, the CPU/NVMe memory sizes, the kv-guard sidecar and its ConfigMap (matches vllm-deployment-tiered.yaml).

enabled.description: Render the tiered variant of the Deployment and the kv-guard ConfigMap.

cpuGiB.description: CPU RAM tier in GiB; rendered as cpu_bytes_to_use = cpuGiB x 1073741824.

nvmeGiB.description: NVMe tier in GiB; sizeLimit of the kv-nvme emptyDir (must fit the instance store).

guardBudgetGiB.description: Byte budget the guard sidecar enforces on the NVMe tier (the BUDGET_GIB env var).

routing.title: AI gateway routing
routing.description: GatewayClass, EnvoyProxy, Gateway and AIGatewayRoute in the gateway namespace.

enabled.description: Render the GatewayClass, EnvoyProxy, Gateway and AIGatewayRoute.

namespace.description: Namespace of the EnvoyProxy and Gateway (and of the AIGatewayRoute's parentRef).

createNamespace.description: Create the gateway namespace; set false when it already exists.

autoscaling.title: KEDA autoscaling
autoscaling.description: Per-cluster bounds and thresholds for the ScaledObject.

minReplicas.description: Replica floor: scale-out is slow (node, image, weights), so never start from zero.

queueThreshold.description: Mean queued requests per pod (Value metric) that pushes scale-out; rendered quoted, so it stays a string.

kvCacheThreshold.description: Hottest pod's KV cache utilization (0 to 1) that pushes scale-out; rendered quoted, so it stays a string.

fallbackReplicas.description: Replicas held when a Prometheus trigger fails 3 polls in a row.

prometheusAddress.description: Prometheus the triggers poll; default is the service the Prometheus stack creates in the observability namespace.

businessHours.description: On-hours floor: a cron window acting as a dynamic minimum.

replicas.description: Dynamic minimum inside the window; rendered quoted, so it stays a string.

enabled.description: Render the PrometheusRule and the metrics-reader ServiceAccount/ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding/Secret.

namespace.description: Namespace of the metrics-reader objects; the ScaledObject's Prometheus address is http://kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus.<namespace>.svc:9090.

createNamespace.description: Create the monitoring namespace; set false when it already exists (the Prometheus stack creates it).
